term: contingent brute concrete root under world-local existential grounding
definition: For a typed Profile of possible complete histories, an actual concrete root is a candidate individual x for which concrete x and ExistsAt w x hold, but there is no actually existing concrete y with grounds w y x. This is a root of the stipulated world-local existential-grounding relation, not necessarily a temporally first event, an uncaused universe or a fully unexplained fact. WellFounded (grounds w) is an additional condition over the whole candidate carrier. The model does not assume all grounds are concrete or that every explanation is a cause.
note: An analyst's model for #505/#487, with deliberately narrow sense of 'brute'. Alternative abstract, intrinsic and global explanations remain open; do not identify absence of modeled concrete predecessors with absolute explanatory absurdism. Application-scope clarification: an abstract Profile theorem leaves grounds parametric; applying it to reality must specify whether an R edge represents a productive existential contributor, an enabling condition, or both. A direct productive contribution need not be individually or jointly sufficient. Profile supplies no endpoint-presence, production, completeness or asymmetry law; ActualConcreteGround guards the source, while ActualRoot and the actual-node graph additionally guard their target. The JointGroups.recorded adapter places all incoming graph neighbours in contributors and leaves enablers empty solely as representation, with no sufficiency claim. It does not choose a productive interpretation. A fixed joint condition is not a new individual and supplies no new Being witness for contingent grounding C. Changing the interpretation affects acceptance of C, cause-to-R F, priority-to-R G and asymmetry O; it does not change the already verified conditional proof. Neither Profile.grounds, Ontic.Causes, the separate PowerExistenceBoundary.supportsEsse nor Aquinas conservation is silently identified with another relation. Roothood excludes selected actual-concrete predecessors only, not every possible explanation or absolute dependence.
